title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime Adaptation Streams in India in January
content: The anime will also stream on Crunchyroll worldwide, excluding Asia, with availability in Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia. Crunchyroll describes its story: A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film Opens in Indian Theaters on January 29, 2027
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will release the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film in Indian theaters on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles as well as dubbed in English.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Will Open in UK and Ireland Cinemas From January 29 2027
content: Crunchyroll has announced in a press release that it and Sony Pictures Entertainment will release the Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film , animated by ufotable in UK and Irland cinemas from January 29, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Ghibli's Arrietty Will Be Released in UK and Ireland IMAX cinemas from October 14
content: In a press release on Thursday, GKIDS has confirmed UK cinema release details for Studio Ghibli 's 2010 film Arrietty , directed by Yoshifumi Kondō . It will be released on Wednesday October 14 and 15 in IMAX cinemas in the UK and Ireland, followed by a wider cinema release from Friday October 16.
author: ANN

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Delays Episodes 49 and 50 to October "to Improve Quality"
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has delayed Episode 49 and Episode 50 to October 2026 in order to “improve quality” as the anime approaches its climax. The anime previously revised the streaming schedule for numerous platforms in Japan.
author: Anime Corner

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Features Renji Abarai Changes in Episode 8 Ending Video
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity premiered Episode 8 “THE END TWO WORLD” on September 12 with new changes to its ending video. While the majority of the video is unchanged, there are several frames that now feature Renji Abarai.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Announces Cast for Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Outback
content: Netflix confirmed production on Friday of its new series Outback (working title), with Jun-Yeol Ryu, Kyung Hong, Ho-yeon Jung, Ji-an Won, and Justin H. Min set to star. Based on the webtoon G'day by Yong Sung Choi, Outback follows Sion, who travels to Australia after his older sister's sudden death.
author: ANN

title: 31 Years Ago, This Shoujo Anime Changed The World in a Way You’d Never Expect
content: Just about every anime fan is familiar with shoujo staples like Ai Yazawa’s Nana , or even her slightly more niche hit series Paradise Kiss , but neither of these generation-defining stories would have been made possible without the success of Neighborhood Story .
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Streams Trailer Highlighting "Yoroshiku★Girl" Segment
content: The Aniplex One Focus livestream event on Saturday revealed a trailer for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story segment of Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque).
author: ANN
